title: STRONGHOLD PROTOCOL: ALLIANCE OPEN
lines: DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain event rewards by leveling up [Stronghold Credit] with [Stronghold Credits], which can be earned by clearing event stages, completing [Key Objectives] missions and Daily Goal; In addition, the [Team Simulation] mode has been added for this event, allowing you to team up with three other players to take on stages together.
REWARDS: MARTHE Sports Line - Blazing Street View for Humus, Event Icon 'Simulation Complete!', Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, etc.

- Daily Goal: Players can obtain [Stronghold Credits] every day through Simulation. Once reached a certain amount, a bonus [Stronghold Credits] reward will be available at the completion screen. This reward can be claimed once per day, refreshing daily at 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Please stay tuned for more details.
02 ORIENTEERING HEADHUNTING OPEN FOR A LIMITED TIME

DETAILS: During the Orienteering Headhunting, you can select and lock in three 6-star and three 5-star Operators of this pool and raise their rates. The three selected 6-star Operators will be the only 6-star Operators in this headhunting.
★★★★★★(2%): Stainless / Tragodia / Ulpianus / Blaze the Igniting Spark / Zuo Le / Swire the Elegant Wit
★★★★★(8%): Gracebearer / Paprika / Firewhistle / Surfer / Nowell / Bassline

◆ This is a Standard Headhunting. Once the rate-up Operators are selected, only the three selected 6-star Operators will appear in this pool, making up 100% of the 6-star Operators' pull rate. All 5-star Operators from the Standard Headhunting pool may appear, while the three selected 5-star Operators have a boosted rate, comprising 60% of the 5-star Operators' pull rate.
◆ For the duration of the current Orienteering Headhunting pool, the rate-up Operators cannot be changed.
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: Module Data Block * 24, Data Supplement Instrument * 30, Data Supplement Stick * 90
Please stay tuned for more information!
